Both gates are red because of four new rustls advisories. Your code and your lockfile did not cause it. The RustSec database published the advisories on 2026-10-14, after the PR runs. That is why commit `01033f84` was green on 2026-10-14 and red on 2026-10-15 with no change to the lockfile. #294 is not the cause, it only got the next run.

**The affected crate:** `rustls` 0.23.45. It is the only rustls version in `Cargo.lock`, and it comes in through the AWS SDK path (`aws-smithy-http-client` → `aws-config` / `aws-sdk-bedrockruntime` → `paigasus-helikon-providers-bedrock`), among others.

| Advisory | Severity | Problem |
|---|---|---|
| RUSTSEC-2026-0346 | 4.0 medium | The `Debug` output of client session values shows TLS secrets |
| RUSTSEC-2026-0347 | 2.3 low | Buffered data goes to the outer server after an ECH rejection |
| RUSTSEC-2026-0348 | 3.7 low | Brotli certificate decompression can allocate up to 1 GiB before authentication |
| RUSTSEC-2026-0349 | 3.7 low | An unauthenticated ServerHello can downgrade later connections to classical key exchange |

**What fails in each gate:**
- `audit` (`cargo audit --deny warnings`) reports "4 vulnerabilities found!".
- `deny` reports these 4 `error[vulnerability]` items and nothing else. Its other output is only warnings, which do not fail the gate.
- Three of those warnings are `advisory-not-detected` for ignore entries that no longer match a crate: RUSTSEC-2024-0384, RUSTSEC-2024-0436 and RUSTSEC-2025-0012. A cleanup of `deny.toml` can remove them, but they are not the cause.

**The fix:** rustls 0.23.46 was released on 2026-10-14 and is not yanked. All four advisories give "Upgrade to >=0.23.46" as the solution. The fix is a lockfile-only `chore(deps)` PR made with `cargo update -p rustls`. It will make every new PR red until it merges.
